annotations.title: List the groups a number belongs to

description:
List the WhatsApp groups this number is a member of.

The list is built when the number connects: every group it belongs to
is picked up then, whether or not anything has been said in it. A group
joined since then is picked up from the join itself, without waiting
for anyone to speak in it.

`name` filters by group name. `include_left=true` also returns groups
this number has left, which are otherwise hidden.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Pass back the `cursor` from the previous response, with the same filters; omit it for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

include_left.description: Include groups this number has left. Off by default, so a plain listing shows only groups the number is currently in.
include_left.title: Include Left

limit.description: How many items to return, 1-200. Defaults to 50.
limit.title: Limit

number_alias.description: Which of the organization's WhatsApp numbers this acts on: `main`, the alias of an extra number, or the number's `id` (`num_…`), which stays the same when the alias is renamed. Call `list_numbers` to see them. Defaults to the main number.
number_alias.title: Number Alias

name: list_groups
title: List the groups a number belongs to
